Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:17 PM

Aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent 6 to 8 core processor, and you'll be well covered for programming under ₹80,000.

RAM: 16 GB is the real minimum. Pick a laptop where it can be upgraded later, since 8 GB struggles with Docker or an emulator.
Processor: Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 (H-series) for speed. Choose a U-series chip if you want better battery life.
Screen: Full HD or better, 14 to 16 inches, and a keyboard you like typing on. You'll look at both all day.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do games or machine learning. That money is better spent on RAM and a good screen.
Weight and battery: Look for 6+ hours of real use if you carry it around.
